mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_reactions (message_id, reply_id, user_id, emoji) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{replyId}, #{userId}, #{emoji})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, reply_id, user_id, emoji, created_at FROM chat_reactions WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND reply_id IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId} AND emoji = #{emoji}
SELECT id, message_id, reply_id, user_id, emoji, created_at FROM chat_reactions WHERE reply_id = #{replyId} AND message_id IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId} AND emoji = #{emoji}
SELECT id, message_id, reply_id, user_id, emoji, created_at FROM chat_reactions WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND reply_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, message_id, reply_id, user_id, emoji, created_at FROM chat_reactions WHERE reply_id = #{replyId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
